article_title: Effect of Mastery Learning on Senior Secondary School Students' Cognitive Learning Outcome in Quantitative Chemistry
citation: Telimoye Leesi Mitee and Georgina N. Obaitan. (2015). Effect of Mastery Learning on Senior Secondary School Students' Cognitive Learning Outcome in Quantitative Chemistry. Journal of Education and Practice, Vol.6, No.5. https://www.iiste.org
title: 25-item Chemistry Achievement Test (CAT) on stoichiometry and mole concept
description: The study's outcome instrument is a 25-item chemistry achievement test (CAT) drawn from stoichiometry and mole concept, used to collect data from 401 Senior Secondary 2 chemistry students as pre-test and post-test. It was pilot tested and reliability was established with Kuder Richardson formula 21, yielding "the reliabi lity coefficient (r = 0.7)."
constraints: Content limited to stoichiometry and mole concept topics
target_learning_goals: Quantitative chemistry achievement (stoichiometry and mole concept)
examples: Administered as pre-test to both groups and as post-test after the two-week treatment
key_sources: Telimoye Leesi Mitee and Georgina N. Obaitan. (2015). Effect of Mastery Learning on Senior Secondary School Students' Cognitive Learning Outcome in Quantitative Chemistry. Journal of Education and Practice, Vol.6, No.5. https://eric.ed.gov/?id=EJ1083639
